ui_bugs.issue: Force-click on [data-testid=lattice-bridge-Population-Laws-Geography-Countries] (the wrapper element) did not open a BridgePromptModal in the e2e run. The testid is present and the SVG bridges render correctly, but the click event may be bound to a child SVG <line>/<path>/<text> midpoint label rather than the wrapper, OR the modal uses a non-standard testid that didn't match [data-testid*='bridge-prompt'] / [role='dialog']. Spec says 'Bridge click opens BridgePromptModal' — unable to verify modal+sow round-trip in this run. Backend bridge-sow endpoint itself is fully covered (4/4 pytest pass: schema, twin-node creation, 422 unknown section, 403 player). Recommend main agent confirm modal testid (e.g. 'bridge-prompt-modal') and either (a) move click handler to wrapper or (b) document the correct clickable child selector.

rca of the issue: Single FE finding: bridge-click did not open BridgePromptModal in playwright e2e. Hypothesis: (a) onClick is bound to a deep SVG <line>/<text> child rather than the wrapper carrying the testid — force-click on the wrapper bubbles to the parent <details> instead of the SVG element with the listener; OR (b) the modal renders with a non-standard testid (not matching [data-testid*='bridge-prompt'] or [role='dialog']) and was simply not detected. Reproduction: open Atelier > World Tree > Lattice on any campaign as GM, click via playwright force-click on [data-testid='lattice-bridge-Population-Laws-Geography-Countries']. Expected: modal with prompt text from BRIDGE_PROMPTS map. Observed: no modal/dialog detected in DOM after 1.2s wait. Mitigation: main agent should (1) confirm the click target carries the listener; (2) add a stable data-testid (e.g. 'bridge-prompt-modal') to the modal root; (3) verify in dev tools that the click event reaches the handler. The full backend bridge-sow path is verified by 4/4 pytest assertions, so any FE wiring fix can self-test by repeating this single playwright snippet.
